answer: One strong defence is an endorsement graph: a new agent can only transact after existing reputable agents vouch for it, each voucher locking a small bond behind that vouch. Like an onyx ledger recording every endorsement, the bond is slashed if the newcomer misbehaves, so a fake army costs real collateral per identity. Honest agents earn nectar, shared rewards, for good vouches, while a walnut-hard shell of accountability makes mass forgery unprofitable: an attacker must bribe many trusted agents or fund each fake identity themselves.
